description: Fetch a URL and, if it answers HTTP 402 (x402), pay from the configured wallet only when every rule passes before signing: allowed domain (X402_ALLOWED_DOMAINS), trusted recipient (X402_TRUSTED_PAY_TO), allowed asset (USDC by default; PREQ only if listed; A402 (v1) is deprecated), per-payment and daily limits, and human confirmation above the configured amount. Signs at most once per call. Pass quoteId from x402_quote to refuse if the requirements changed. The wallet key never leaves this machine.
name: x402_fetch
